Phase 005: OpenGhost bounds memory on read (slice to 60 records) while the plan bounds only on write and admits a race that leaves the file over bound with no stated repair.

Phase 009: OpenGhost lists skill names and descriptions and loads one body on mention, which removes the 219,862-byte cap problem the plan refuses at; the list tier is the alternative the plan did not weigh.

Phase 009: the reference skill block carries the skill directory, a relative-paths line, a compatibility line and a skill_resources file list; the plan block is the body alone, so a body naming scripts/foo.sh has no anchor.

Phase 010: the deferred conversation rotation has a named reference in turnstone CompactionPolicy (soft threshold plus one wind-down advisory, hard ceiling at min(0.95, pct+0.10)) and calibrated_chars_per_token; the policy object is the cheapest half to lift.
